title: South Irrigation will remain off the weekend due to a major leak at the South Well

summary: South Irrigation will be off for the weekend due…
public_detail: South Irrigation will be off for the weekend due to a major leak at the south well. The repairs will be completed on Monday. Reminder, there are rain sensors on the well. If there is significant rain the wells will shut off for 24 to 48hours. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
